Method of Attack: Spoofing MAC addresses to send power-saving frames to access points, forcing them to queue frames destined for the target device, then sending wake-up frames to retrieve the frame stack in plaintext or attacker-controlled encryption
Manipulating data transmission, client spoofing, frame redirection, and capturing
Injecting malicious content such as JavaScript into TCP packets by injecting off-path TCP packets with spoofed sender IP addresses
Impacted Systems: Network devices from Lancom, Aruba, Cisco, Asus, and D-Link
Attack Vector: Spoofed MAC address and power-saving frames to access points
Sending authentication and association frames to change security context of frames
Indicators of Compromise: Frames transmitted in plaintext or encrypted with attacker-provided keys
Use of custom tool MacStealer to test WiFi networks for client isolation bypasses and intercept traffic at MAC layer
